quarterly_data.quarter: Hwatsing Technology results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (04-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Board secretary Chen Zhenyin (results briefing): Q1 2026 revenue was RMB 12.01 hundred million, up 31.66%; net profit attributable RMB 2.47 hundred million, up 5.95%; recurring net profit RMB 2.25 hundred million, up 5.97%. CFO Wang Huaixu said gross margin edged down because some products recognised as revenue are still in market development with lower margins. Chairman Wang Tongqing said the company opened overseas markets with some revenue in 2025.
